title: Repair the length boundary in bounded subarray counting
goal: Implement count_bounded_sums(items, target, max_length) for a list of integers and integer target/max_length. Count all nonempty contiguous subarrays whose sum equals target and whose length is at most max_length, including length exactly max_length. Count intervals at different positions separately, even if their values are equal. Values may be negative or zero. A positive max_length greater than the input length permits all subarray lengths. Empty input returns 0. A non-positive max_length raises ValueError, even for empty input. Do not mutate items.
constraints: Only edit solution.py; do not add files or dependencies or modify tests.
Keep the public function count_bounded_sums(items, target, max_length) and its signature unchanged.

provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct authored inputs and bounded independent checks of the same stated specification
